title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
ETH +18.5% (24h) → $2,267 — $1.9B short-liquidation cascade broke $1,950 range; spot ETF inflows $189M (Aug 19).
US Jobless Claims (Aug 15 wk) 206K vs 210K expected — labor tight, mild hawkish lean.
BTC +6.46% (24h) → ~$69K suppressed (already alerted 07:15Z, <1.5x prior move).
